about: A 20 to 40 second launch film made from a product's own site, the launch pictures, and a check for any video.

tools.name: make_launch_film
tools.title: Launch film from a website
tools.description: Makes a 20 to 40 second launch film from a product's own site: it reads the brand and the page, plans the film (name and promise, the real screen in a browser window, the page's own headline, feature cards, a number the page states, the logo close) and renders film.mp4 with music and sound effects, all with Chrome and ffmpeg on this machine. Nothing is generated by AI: the film shows what the site says. film.json is the plan; edit it and call render_launch_film to render again. Rendering takes a few minutes.
tools.hostedDescription: Makes a 20 to 40 second launch film from a product's own site: it reads the brand and the page, plans the film (name and promise, the real screen in a browser window, the page's own headline, feature cards, a number the page states, the logo close) and renders film.mp4 with music and sound effects. Nothing is generated by AI: the film shows what the site says. film.json is the plan, and render_launch_film renders it again from job:<job_id>/film.json. A film.json cannot be changed here yet, so it renders as it was planned. Rendering takes a few minutes.

look.description: The film's look (default: picked from the brand). launch_film_guide with topic looks says what each one suits.

brand.description: A brand kit you already have: an easybrandkit folder or its brand.json.
brand.hostedDescription: A brand kit an earlier make_brand_kit job saved, as job:<job_id>/brand.json, so its logo files come with it.

words.description: A words.json you already have, instead of reading the page again.

music.description: Set to false to leave out the music bed.

sfx.description: Set to false to leave out the sound effects.

keep.description: Keep the work files, each clip's MP4.

tools.name: plan_launch_film
tools.title: Plan a launch film
tools.description: Reads a product's brand and page and writes film.json, the plan of a launch film, without rendering it. Edit film.json (launch_film_guide with topic types lists the scene types and their fields), then call render_launch_film.
tools.hostedDescription: Reads a product's brand and page and writes film.json, the plan of a launch film, without rendering it. Read the plan, then give job:<job_id>/film.json to render_launch_film to render it, or to make_launch_stills for pictures that match it. A film.json cannot be changed here yet, so it renders as it was planned.

look.description: The film's look (default: picked from the brand).

brand.description: A brand kit you already have: an easybrandkit folder or its brand.json.
brand.hostedDescription: A brand kit an earlier make_brand_kit job saved, as job:<job_id>/brand.json, so its logo files come with it.

words.description: A words.json you already have, instead of reading the page again.

music.description: Set to false to plan the film without the music bed.

sfx.description: Set to false to plan the film without sound effects.

tools.name: render_launch_film
tools.title: Render a launch film
tools.description: Renders a film.json into film.mp4 next to it, with Chrome and ffmpeg on this machine. Use it after plan_launch_film or after editing the film.json of make_launch_film. Rendering takes a few minutes.
tools.hostedDescription: Renders the film.json of an earlier make_launch_film or plan_launch_film job into film.mp4, as it was planned. Rendering takes a few minutes.

film.hostedDescription: The film.json an earlier job saved, as job:<job_id>/film.json, so the brand and screens it names come with it.

keep.description: Keep the work files, each clip's MP4.

tools.name: make_launch_stills
tools.title: Launch pictures
tools.description: Makes the pictures a launch needs at the exact size each place asks for: Product Hunt (ph), link previews (og), X (x), Google Play (play) and the Chrome Web Store (chrome). They come from the film's look, the brand's logo and the site's real screen, as opaque PNGs in stills/, listed in STILLS.md. Give a site and it plans a film first, or give a film.json so the pictures match the film.

source.description: The product's website, like https://linear.app, or a film.json you already have, whose stills/ go next to it.
source.hostedDescription: The product's website, like https://linear.app, or the film.json an earlier job saved, as job:<job_id>/film.json, so the pictures match that film. A link is read as the website, and one that ends in .json is refused.

for.description: Which places to make pictures for (default all of them).

tools.name: check_video
tools.title: Check a video
tools.description: Checks any rendered video by measuring it: size, frame rate, length, black, still and silent stretches, loudness, peaks, and whether the cuts land on the beat. Writes CHECK.md (pass or fail, with every check), check.json, sheet.png (a frame from each shot) and wave.png. A failed check is a normal result here; read CHECK.md for what to fix.

film.description: The video to check, like film.mp4.

expect.description: The size and frame rate it should have, like 1920x1080@30.

seconds.description: The length it should have: 30 (give or take half a second) or a range like 28-32.

lufs.description: The integrated loudness it should have, like -14 (give or take 1 LU).

cues.description: The music's cues.json (from fit_music), to check the cuts land on the beat.

cuts.description: The cuts in seconds, like 3.2,7.5, or a JSON file, when the video has no timeline from launch-film.

allow.description: Stretches meant to hold still, black or silent, in seconds, like 27-30,0-0.5.

tools.name: launch_film_guide
tools.title: Launch film looks and scene types
tools.description: Lists launch-film's looks and what each one suits (topic looks), or its scene types and their fields (topic types), for picking a look or editing film.json.
tools.hostedDescription: Lists launch-film's looks and what each one suits (topic looks), or its scene types and their fields (topic types), for picking a look or reading a film.json.
